faq.q: Where is Trai Inc HQ located in Lucknow?
faq.a: Our Global Engineering HQ is located at Tower B-2, 1109, 11th Floor, DLF MyPad, Vibhuti Khand, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow 226010 (opposite Hyatt Regency).

faq.q: How can founders connect for startup incubation scoping?
faq.a: All technical discovery sessions and founder strategy calls are held online via Google Meet or Zoom. You can book an online strategy session directly through our website.

faq.q: Do you offer DPIIT and Startup India grant assistance in Lucknow?
faq.a: Yes. Our incubation desk assists high-conviction founders with DPIIT registration, Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS up to ₹50 Lakhs), and UP Startup Policy grant documentation.
